timeline.summary: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals announced shareholder approval for a buyback of up to 16 lakh shares at ₹250 each for ₹40 Cr.
Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals received shareholder approval for a ₹40 Cr share buyback at ₹250 per share.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹64.2 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit ₹8.76 Cr (+33.1% YoY).
Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals announced Q4FY26 revenue of ₹64.2 Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹44.6 Cr alongside a ₹40 Cr buyback and 200% dividend.
Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited hosted Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on April 28, 2026, at 3:00 PM, with recording available on its website.
Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call detailing operational recovery and capital allocation plans.
Jagsonpal Pharma submitted Letter of Offer for ₹40 Cr buyback at ₹250/share opening May 8, 2026.
Jagsonpal Pharma completed the extinguishment of 16,00,000 equity shares bought back for ₹40 Cr, reducing total equity capital to ₹13.11 Cr.
Infinity Holdings, via **Ahmad Tariq Hossanee (Director)**, declares no encumbrance of Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals shares during FY2026 under SEBI’s Reg 31(4).
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹96.37 Cr, net profit ₹12.29 Cr.
Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited made the audio recording of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call available on its website on October 29, 2026.
